source_class: Constant distinct frequencies over actual monitor interval; common frequency shift arbitrary; independent frequency and duration bounds. Time warping/nonstationarity must be separately bounded in monitor error or a new model.
gram_bound: q_lm=abs(n_l-n_m)*rho+2*eta*T0*(1+rho); offdiag<=q_lm/(abs(n_l-n_m)-q_lm) when denominator positive; lambda_lower=1-max_row_sum.
monitor_error_scope: Normalized L2 error of isolated finite-mode waveform estimate; include projected outside-model contamination, clock normalization, gain, numerical and reference uncertainty. Not merely electronics noise.
negative_controls: prior60uV RMS does not fit this robust sufficient budget
50mHz mode errors fail selected lambda/TV sufficient gate
500mHz errors permit adjacent collision and return HOLD
near-collision distinct tones have small RMS and large TV
claim_scope: Source/monitor design only; no measured offsets, experiment or admission; original orthogonal theorem remains a special case.
